newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan will keep close watch on stock movements-MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan will keep close watch on stock movements-MOF.

text.p: The Japanese government will keep a close watch on stock price movements, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Friday.
"We are deeply interested in the stock price situation and will keep a close watch on developments," he said.
Asked if the recent plunge in Japanese stock prices would force Japanese financial institutions to sell U.S. bonds and stocks, Mitsuzuka said:
"Financial markets move on varying factors and it is important to stay calm.
"The basic thing is to listen to what the markets say about markets," he said, without elaborating.
Mitsuzuka said financial markets were asking the Japanese government to carry out various reforms.
"We are determined to carry out the reforms steadily and without fail," he said.

The government, private research institutions and Japanese companies have recognised that the Japanese economy is recovering gradually and it is important for Japanese companies to have confidence in the future course of the economy when doing business, Mitsuzuka said.
